title: pps teach you a language?
intro: Have you ever used Duolingo, Babbel, Busuu or perhaps another language-learning app? How did you get on? Some people love the convenience of these apps – you can learn on the go, like during your commute to work, rather than committing to a certain time each week, like learning in a class. But are they teaching the languages effectively? Neil and Pippa discuss this and teach you some new vocabulary.
this_week_question: Which of these is not currently a language you can learn using Duolingo?
a) Latin b) Klingon c) Elvish
Listen to the programme to hear the answer.

vocab.desc: suggested or understood without being directly stated explicit communicated clearly and directly immersion experience of being completely surrounded by something key finding most important conclusion or discovery from a piece of research promising showing signs of being positive one particular one specific individual thing or person
